name: Sorority Sister Sleuths: London Calling
source:
Three recently graduated college co-eds, close friends who lived in the same sorority house at the University of Washington, embark on a summer-long trip across Europe, encountering mystery, intrigue, and romance at every destination.  First stop: London!

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190825224526/http://questerentertainment.com/sorority-sister-sleuths-2/]official site[/url]]
translation:
三名刚毕业的女大学生是华盛顿大学同一姐妹会的好友，她们踏上横跨欧洲、持续整个夏季的旅程，在每个目的地遇到谜团、阴谋与爱情。第一站：伦敦！

[来源：[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190825224526/http://questerentertainment.com/sorority-sister-sleuths-2/]官方网站[/url]]
